# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c36 P31](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0031)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c36 P31](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

He has dimples in his elbows.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004)_

## History

Prior to his birth, his mother Nell Harcourt studied child-rearing books and planned to avoid baby talk, though she abandoned the rule immediately upon holding him. He was cared for by Nell, who adored him and intended alongside Miss Winifred to raise him to be a fine Conservative. As he grew, Nell and Lorna put him into shorter clothes, though putting on his long nightgown at night restored his familiar appearance to his mother.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c36 P31](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0031), [v4 c36 P32](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0032), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053)_
